INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id 
INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T1.link_to_member = T3.member_id 
WHERE T2.event_name = "Women's Soccer" AND T3.t_shirt_size = 'M'

SELECT T3.event_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Maya' AND T1.last_name = 'Mclean';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT attendance.link_to_event) 
FROM member 
INNER JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member 
INNER JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE member.first_name = 'Sacha' 
  AND member.last_name = 'Harrison' 
  AND strftime('%Y', event.event_date) = '2019'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name  
FROM member AS T1  
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member  
INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id  
WHERE T3.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud'

SELECT e.expense_id, e.approved
FROM event AS ev
JOIN budget AS b ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense AS e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE ev.event_date = '2019-10-08';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name  
FROM event e  
INNER JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event  
INNER JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id  
WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name
FROM major AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T1.major_id = T3.link_to_major
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T3.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T2.link_to_event = T4.event_id
WHERE T1.major_name = 'interior design' AND T4.event_name = 'Community Theater';
SELECT SUM(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense AS exp ON b.budget_id = exp.link_to_budget
INNER JOIN member AS m ON exp.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT T1.event_name  
FROM event AS T1  
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event  
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC  
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.spent ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(T1.spent)) AS percentage
FROM budget AS T1
INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT T2.link_to_event) AS number_of_events_attended,
    T3.major_name
FROM 
    member AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN 
    major AS T3 ON T1.link_to_major = T3.major_id
WHERE 
    T1.first_name = 'Luisa' AND T1.last_name = 'Guidi';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS attended
FROM attendance AS a
INNER JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
INNER JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' 
  AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' 
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT expense.cost
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
JOIN expense ON budget.budget_id = expense.link_to_budget
WHERE event.event_name = 'September Speaker'
  AND expense.expense_description = 'posters'

SELECT 
    budget.category AS expense_type, 
    SUM(expense.cost) AS total_approved_value
FROM expense 
INNER JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id 
WHERE expense.approved = 'Yes' 
    AND budget.category = 'October Meeting' 
GROUP BY budget.category;

SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id
WHERE T3.position = 'vice president'
  AND T1.location = '900 E. Washington St.'
  AND T1.type = 'social';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
INNER JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
INNER JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = "women's soccer";

SELECT event.event_name, event.event_date 
FROM event 
INNER JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event 
INNER JOIN expense ON budget.budget_id = expense.link_to_budget 
WHERE expense.expense_description LIKE '%pizza%' 
AND expense.cost > 50 
AND expense.cost < 100;

SELECT DISTINCT
    z.city,
    z.county
FROM event e
JOIN zip_code z ON CAST(e.location AS INTEGER) = z.zip_code
WHERE e.event_id IN (
    SELECT e2.event_id
    FROM event e2
    JOIN attendance a2 ON e2.event_id = a2.link_to_event
    JOIN member m2 ON a2.link_to_member = m2.member_id
    JOIN income i2 ON m2.member_id = i2.link_to_member
    GROUP BY e2.event_id
    HAVING COUNT(i2.income_id) > 40
);

SELECT 
    m.member_id, 
    m.first_name, 
    m.last_name, 
    SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM member m
INNER JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE m.member_id IN (
    SELECT link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT expense_date) > 1
)
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(budget.spent) * 100.0 / SUM(budget.amount) 
FROM 
    budget 
    INNER JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE 
    event.type = 'Game';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
ORDER BY SUM(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.f_name || ' ' || s.l_name AS full_name,
    d.donation_total AS amount_received
FROM student s
JOIN donations d ON CAST(s.student_id AS TEXT) = d.donor_acctid
WHERE DATE(d.donation_timestamp) = '2019-09-09'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Description
FROM products AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2
ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID
WHERE T2.Date >= '2013-09-01' AND T2.Date < '2013-10-01';
